snapshot.name: Palantir Defense OSDK reference v1 candidate
snapshot.capture_method: Official Palantir Defense OSDK root/API pages plus recent official indexed interface pages; normalized manually in ChatGPT.
snapshot.important_note: Canonical matching key should be sdk_id. Display labels can drift.

interfaces.name: COMINT
interfaces.official_description: The communications signals intelligence (COMINT) interface defines the shape of COMINT objects and extends the SIGINT and Intelligence interfaces.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 통신신호정보. SIGINT를 직접 확장하고 CENOT 식별 표기를 추가.

declared_properties.name: CENOT
declared_properties.description: Communications emitter notation.

notes: Official description says 'extends the SIGINT and Intelligence interfaces'; explicit Extended interfaces section lists only SIGINT. Intelligence is inherited transitively through SIGINT.

interfaces.name: ELINT
interfaces.official_description: The electronic signals intelligence (ELINT) interface defines the shape of ELINT objects and extends the SIGINT and Intelligence interfaces.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 비통신 전자신호 정보. SIGINT를 직접 확장하고 ELNOT 식별 표기를 추가.

declared_properties.name: ELNOT
declared_properties.description: Electronic intelligence notation.

notes: Official description says 'extends the SIGINT and Intelligence interfaces'; explicit Extended interfaces section lists only SIGINT. Intelligence is inherited transitively through SIGINT.

interfaces.name: GEOINT
interfaces.official_description: Represents GEOINT which extends the Intelligence interface.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 지리공간정보의 상위 인터페이스. OPIR·MTI·IMINT가 이를 확장.

interfaces.name: IMINT
interfaces.official_description: Represents IMINT which extends the GEOINT interface.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 영상정보. 관측 이미지의 URL 또는 media reference를 직접 보유.

declared_properties.name: Image Media URL
declared_properties.description: Media URL for image associated with an IMINT observation.

declared_properties.name: Image Media Reference
declared_properties.description: Media reference for image associated with an IMINT observation.

interfaces.name: Intelligence
interfaces.official_description: Categorized intelligence alongside its most critical metadata, such as its originating source system, location, and last updated time.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 정보 산출물/정보 객체의 공통 상위 인터페이스. 신뢰도·보고시각·보고위치와 정보 대상/생산자 및 각종 평가의 근거 연결을 제공.

declared_properties.name: Normalized Confidence
declared_properties.description: Intelligence confidence normalized to a 1-5 scale.

declared_properties.name: Reported Timestamp
declared_properties.description: Reported timestamp.

declared_properties.name: Reported Position
declared_properties.description: Reported position.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Intelligence Producers
outgoing_link_constraints.description: One intelligence object may link to many intelligence producers.

outgoing_link_constraints.description: Supporting evidence for change assessments.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Physical Assessments
outgoing_link_constraints.description: Supporting evidence for physical assessments.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Functional Assessments
outgoing_link_constraints.description: Supporting evidence for functional assessments.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Collateral Damage Assessments
outgoing_link_constraints.description: Supporting evidence for collateral damage assessments.

interfaces.name: Intelligence Producer
interfaces.official_description: Represents an entity/object which can produce intelligence. One intelligence producer may have links to many intelligence objects.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 정보를 생산하는 출처·생산 주체를 표현. 센서/기관/플랫폼 등의 구체 Object Type이 이 인터페이스를 구현할 수 있음.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Intelligence
outgoing_link_constraints.description: One intelligence producer may link to many intelligence objects.

incoming_link_constraints.name: Intelligence Producers
incoming_link_constraints.description: One intelligence object may link to many intelligence producers.

notes: Recent official search index exposes an incoming link constraint that an older cached page omitted.

interfaces.name: Intelligence Report
interfaces.official_description: The Intelligence Report interface defines the shape of Intelligence report objects and extends the Intelligence interface.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 텍스트·미디어 형태의 정보보고서. 공식 페이지의 상속 설명과 explicit Extended interfaces 표기가 서로 일치하지 않아 비교 시 주의 필요.

declared_properties.name: Media Reference
declared_properties.description: Media from an intelligence report.

declared_properties.name: Report Text
declared_properties.description: Text from an intelligence report.

notes: Documentation discrepancy: prose says this interface extends Intelligence, but the explicit 'Extended interfaces' section lists Report. Do not infer an Intelligence inheritance edge until Palantir clarifies or metadata is queried from a live OSDK client.

interfaces.name: Intelligence Subject
interfaces.official_description: Represents entity which intelligence can be collected on. One intelligence subject object may have many links to intelligence objects.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 정보수집·분석의 대상이 되는 실체를 표현. Targetable Entity의 상위 인터페이스이며 정보 및 물리/기능 평가와 연결됨.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Intelligence
outgoing_link_constraints.description: One intelligence subject may link to many intelligence objects.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Physical Assessments
outgoing_link_constraints.description: One intelligence subject may have many physical assessments.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Functional Assessments
outgoing_link_constraints.description: One intelligence subject may have many functional assessments.

notes: Recent official search index includes Physical/Functional Assessment links; older cached page variants omitted these links. This v2 uses the more recent indexed schema.

interfaces.name: OSINT
interfaces.official_description: Represents OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) which extends the Intelligence interface.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 공개출처정보. 자체 속성보다 Intelligence의 공통 메타데이터와 관계를 상속해 사용.

interfaces.name: SIGINT
interfaces.official_description: The signals intelligence (SIGINT) interface defines the shape of SIGINT objects and extends the Intelligence interface.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 신호정보의 상위 인터페이스. 주파수와 위치 불확실성 타원, 방향 정보를 갖고 ELINT·COMINT의 상위가 됨.

interfaces.name: Aimpoint Weapon Employment
interfaces.official_description: The pairing of a physical weapon against a single geospatial point of a target.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 하나의 표적 좌표에 특정 물리 무장을 배정한 Effector Employment.

interfaces.name: Attack Guidance
interfaces.official_description: Outlines the prioritized desired effects on target types and the methods with which those effects are approved to be carried out.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 어떤 Target Type에 어떤 효과를 어느 우선순위와 수단으로 적용할지 표현하는 공격 지침.

interfaces.name: Attack Guidance Matrix
interfaces.official_description: A grouping of attack guidances for an operation.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 작전별 공격 지침들의 집합.

interfaces.name: Change Assessment
interfaces.official_description: [deprecated] The change assessment interface defines information needed to identify measurable change of a target resulting from the application of lethal or nonlethal military force. Use the physicalAssessment interface instead.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적의 물리적 변화 평가를 나타내던 구형 인터페이스. 현재는 Physical Assessment 사용 권고.
notes: Recent official page explicitly says to use Physical Assessment instead.

interfaces.name: Collateral Concern Candidate
interfaces.official_description: Interface which indicates entities may be identified as collateral concerns.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 부수피해 우려 대상으로 지정될 수 있는 실체의 공통 인터페이스.

interfaces.name: Collateral Concern Guidance
interfaces.official_description: A set of collateral concern lists that should be referenced in specified targeting operations or areas.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 특정 Targeting Operation/Area에서 어떤 부수피해 우려 목록을 어떤 탐색반경으로 확인할지 지정.

interfaces.name: Collateral Concern List
interfaces.official_description: Defines a collection of collateral concerns that can be referenced during the target development process.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적 개발 시 함께 검토해야 할 부수피해 우려 대상들의 목록.

declared_properties.name: Description
declared_properties.description: Human-readable description of a collateral concern list.

outgoing_link_constraints.description: Members of this collateral concern list.

outgoing_link_constraints.name: Collateral Concern Guidances
outgoing_link_constraints.description: Guidances referencing this list.

interfaces.name: Collateral Damage Assessment
interfaces.official_description: The collateral damage assessment interface defines information needed to identify unintended or incidental damage to civilian persons, property, and the environment that may result from military operations, particularly the use of force.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 군사행동으로 발생한 비의도적 민간·재산·환경 피해를 평가.

interfaces.name: Effector Employment
interfaces.official_description: An employment of an effector to create an effect on a discrete part of a target.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적의 특정 부분에 효과를 만들기 위해 효과기/무장을 운용하는 행위.

interfaces.name: Engagement
interfaces.official_description: An action assigned to a target to be executed once the target has been authorized for action.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 승인된 Target에 대해 실제로 실행되는 행동/교전 과업. Operation을 확장하며 사후 평가들과 연결.

incoming_link_constraints.name: Engagements
incoming_link_constraints.description: Observed on recent Target Effect Solution / Engagement indexed pages.

interfaces.name: Fire Support Coordination Measure
interfaces.official_description: Represents the entity of a Fire Support Coordination Measure.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 화력지원 조정구역/조치의 유효기간·형상·고도·소유/조정/면제 부대를 표현.

interfaces.name: Functional Assessment
interfaces.official_description: The functional assessment interface defines information needed to estimate the effect of military force to degrade or destroy the functional or operational capability of a target.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적의 기능·운용 능력이 얼마나 저하되었는지를 평가.

interfaces.name: Geometry-Based Collateral Concern Candidate
interfaces.official_description: Interface which indicates entities may be identified as collateral concerns by geoshapes.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 면/형상으로 표현되는 부수피해 우려 대상.

declared_properties.name: Geometry
declared_properties.description: The geometry of a collateral concern entity.

interfaces.name: High Payoff Target List
interfaces.official_description: A grouping of target priorities for an operation.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 작전에서 고가치/고효용 표적 유형의 우선순위를 묶은 구조.

interfaces.name: Munition Effectiveness Assessment
interfaces.official_description: An evaluation of whether a munition struck as intended and achieved the desired effects, including the assessment's scope, time, location, and confidence level.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 탄약이 의도한 지점에 명중했고 원하는 효과를 냈는지 평가.

interfaces.name: Physical Assessment
interfaces.official_description: The physical assessment interface defines information needed to identify measurable physical damage of a target resulting from the application of lethal or nonlethal military force.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적의 물리적 피해 수준을 평가. Change Assessment의 후속 모델.
notes: Official page was recently indexed, but the root sidebar snapshot used in this session does not list it. It is explicitly named as replacement for deprecated Change Assessment.

interfaces.name: Point-Based Collateral Concern Candidate
interfaces.official_description: Interface which indicates entities may be identified as collateral concerns by geopoints.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 점 위치로 표현되는 부수피해 우려 대상.

declared_properties.name: Location
declared_properties.description: The location of a point-based collateral concern entity.

interfaces.name: Serviced Assessment
interfaces.official_description: A analysis of the effects that a single targeting endeavor had on the corresponding entity.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 해당 표적에 실제 효과를 가하려는 시도가 있었는지를 나타내는 평가.

declared_properties.name: Serviced
declared_properties.description: Indicates whether an attempt was made to effect this target.

notes: Recent indexed page uses display name 'Serviced Assessment' and links it to Engagement.

Older page for the same SDK id displayed 'Target Assessment' and linked to Target, Functional Assessment, Change Assessment, and Collateral Damage Assessment. Treat as version drift, not simultaneous semantics.

interfaces.name: Target
interfaces.official_description: A task representing a single combined attempt to impose an effect on a targetable entity.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 물리적 표적 자체가 아니라 특정 Targetable Entity에 효과를 가하려는 하나의 표적화 과업.

declared_properties.name: Target Number
declared_properties.description: A shorthand alphanumeric identifier for the target.

declared_properties.name: Desired Effect
declared_properties.description: The desired effect to be achieved on the target.

notes: Target Effect Solution page separately exposes 'Selected Target Effect Solution' and 'Proposed Target Effect Solutions' incoming links; page versions appear temporarily inconsistent.

interfaces.name: Target Effect Solution
interfaces.official_description: A collection of effects that, when combined, aim to achieve a particular functional effect on the target.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적에 원하는 기능적 효과를 내기 위해 조합한 하나 이상의 effect/effector employment 묶음.

interfaces.name: Target Engagement Authority
interfaces.official_description: A mandate given by a commander to a unit to direct target engagement on approved targets within an operational area.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 작전구역 내 승인된 표적 교전을 지휘하도록 특정 부대에 부여된 권한.

interfaces.name: Target List
interfaces.official_description: A set of Targets.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 여러 Target을 묶는 목록. Target과의 멤버십은 Target List Assignment로 객체화됨.

interfaces.name: Target List Assignment
interfaces.official_description: An assignment of Target to Target List.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: Target-Target List 멤버십 자체를 객체화한 관계. 목록별 priority를 관계 속성으로 보유.

declared_properties.name: Priority
declared_properties.description: The priority of the Target on the specific Target List.

interfaces.name: Target Priority
interfaces.official_description: A number indicating the relative level of priority with which to engage a given target type.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 특정 Target Type의 상대적 교전 우선순위.

declared_properties.name: Priority
declared_properties.description: The priority level of the target type.

interfaces.name: Target Selection Standard
interfaces.official_description: The accuracy requirements and specific criteria that must be met before targets of a certain type can be engaged.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 특정 유형의 표적을 교전하기 전에 충족해야 할 정확도·정보 최신성·기동성 기준.

interfaces.name: Target Selection Standard Matrix
interfaces.official_description: A grouping of target selection standards for an operation.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 작전별 표적선정 기준들의 집합.

interfaces.name: Target Type
interfaces.official_description: The categorization of equipment, building, organization, or other strategic asset.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적이 될 수 있는 군사적 실체의 유형 분류.

declared_properties.name: Target Type
declared_properties.description: The most specific and common designation of the target type.

interfaces.name: Targetable Entity
interfaces.official_description: A non-fungible representation of a corporeal asset with military significance.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 군사적 의미를 갖는 실제 물리 자산. 정보수집 대상(Intelligence Subject)이면서 여러 번의 Target 설정 대상이 될 수 있음.

declared_properties.name: Location
declared_properties.description: The geospatial position of the targetable entity.

interfaces.name: Targeting Area
interfaces.official_description: A portion physical space divided for the purpose of managing and delegating targeting responsibilities.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적화 책임을 관리·위임하기 위해 구획한 공간.

declared_properties.name: Area
declared_properties.description: The geoshape representing this targeting area.

interfaces.name: Targeting Operation
interfaces.official_description: A military planning structure characterized as a source for targeting guidance.
interfaces.semantic_summary_ko: 표적화 지침의 기준이 되는 군사 계획 구조. Operation을 확장.
